question: Select an appropriate title for the given passage.

options.text: Natural Habitats of Flamingos – A Brief Overview
Origin and Effect of Beta-carotene on Humans
How Do Flamingos Become Pink? – A Study

solution:
The correct title for the given passage is "How Do Flamingos Become Pink? – A Study".

The reason this title is most appropriate is because the primary focus of the passage is to explain the process through which flamingos acquire their iconic pink color. It describes how flamingos are born grey, and then turn pink because of their specific diet, which is rich in beta-carotene.

As for the other options:

"Natural Habitats of Flamingos – A Brief Overview": The passage does not primarily focus on the habitats of flamingos. Although it briefly mentions their habitat, it does not go into any detail about it.

"Origin and Effect of Beta-carotene on Humans": While the passage does mention beta-carotene and briefly refers to its effect on humans, this is not the main focus of the passage.

"Identifying Different Species of Flamingos": The passage does mention there are different species of flamingos, but it does not provide any information to help readers identify different species. Thus, this would not be an accurate title.
